offering_description.value: Provides B2B purchase intent data, lead generation and marketing services to technology vendors, delivered through a network of IT buyer-focused websites, research content and events.

primary_products.value: purchase intent data; lead generation programs; IT buyer research content; events and webinars

primary_services.value: account-based marketing; custom content creation; campaign management; event sponsorship services

customer_segment.value: B2B: technology vendors and IT service providers marketing to enterprise IT buyers

end_markets.value: enterprise technology; information technology; cybersecurity; cloud computing

revenue_model.value: subscription: vendors paying for purchase intent data and platform access; advertising: vendors paying for sponsored content and lead generation; project or contract: custom marketing campaigns for technology vendors; other: conference and event sponsorships
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; project or contract; other

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in IT buyer audience and intent data, sells marketing services to technology vendors; software / platform: operates data platform that matches buyer intent to vendor marketing; other: publishes IT buyer websites and research content

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and other international markets with IT buyer audiences

specialization.value: related lines: IT buyer websites and research content, purchase intent data, marketing services, and events

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling marketing programs and data to technology vendors; online: IT buyer websites and digital content delivered to professional audiences

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR and CCPA governing collection and use of buyer data

notes: Company was renamed Informa TechTarget after its 2024 merger with Informa Tech; the provided website address matches that later name, so details reflect the combined business as I know it.
